frequency_question: What proportion of comparable central bank operational cycles feature the deployment of secondary reserve ratio adjustments within a four-month window?
membership_rule: Includes all instances where a major emerging market central bank faced with transient systemic liquidity surpluses implemented secondary or incremental reserve ratio tools. Excludes standard permanent changes to baseline reserve requirements.

cases.name: PBoC reserve requirement ratio targeted adjustment (2022)
Bank Indonesia secondary reserve requirement adjustment (2021)
Central Bank of Brazil compulsory deposit adjustment (2021)
RBI incremental CRR historical equivalent (2016 demonetisation absorption)

provenance_note: claims 40 cases from only 5 named (8.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 5 named primary reference points; believed roughly 40 comparable liquidity surplus episodes globally in the past decade.
known_gaps: Varying definitions of secondary reserve requirements across different legal jurisdictions.
skeleton: Total recorded distinct liquidity-surplus episodes across major emerging market central banks over the past decade
multiplier: 5 targeted episodes identified in detail out of approximately 40 major liquidity-management review cycles globally where transient excess liquidity spikes occurred.
validity_reason: Central bank operational toolkits evolve slowly over structural monetary policy regimes.
